system.signatureText:
Once per scene, move through any space a spider could theoretically fit — a crack, a pipe, the gap under a door — no roll, no Alert increase, regardless of the current Alert Level. You arrive on the far side the same turn.

Use it to get into a room, out of a room, or, in one documented case, away from a cat so fast the cat sat down and pretended it had never cared.
system.blurb:
“I was never here. That shadow wasn't moving. Go back to sleep.”

The Ghost lives in the spaces between spaces — vents, wall gaps, the three squares behind the fridge nobody has cleaned since 2018. Where others work around security, the Ghost simply isn't there when it looks.

Role Bonus: +3 points split between Stealth and Acrobatics.
